rules.name: Star Destroyers
rules.description: Your army must include more Heavy Support choices than Fast Attack choices.

rules.name: Curse of the Flayer
rules.description: Your army must include at least 1 unit of Flayed One per 1000pts.

rules.name: The Light of the Stars
rules.description: Your army must include more Fast Attack choices than Heavy Support choices.

rules.name: Codes of Combat
rules.description: During deployment, select a single enemy unit with the Character special rule. If the chosen unit is not slain in the Combat Phase by the end of the game, the Necron player loses 1 Victory Point.

rules.name: Reanimation Nodes
rules.description:
At the start of your Movement Phase, friendly Necron units within 12” of a model in this unit can either:
• Heal 1 additional wound.
• Re-Roll Regeneration Rolls.
• Return 1 additional model to a unit with 1 Wound remaining.

rules.name: Translocation Protocols
rules.description: If this unit is within 3” of a friendly Cryptek at the end of your Shooting Phase, this unit may be removed from the battlefield. Place this unit back down on the battlefield anywhere more than 3” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Necron Overlord
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A), and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, the model gains a Tachyon Arrow. The unit also gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Royal Retainers
rules.description: For each Necron Lord in your army, you may include 1 Royal Warden unit without taking up a Force Organization Slot.

rules.name: Plasmancer
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Living Lightning wargear.

rules.name: Psychomancer
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade has the Fear (4) special rule.

rules.name: Geomancer
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade grants Heavy Cover to any attached unit. If the unit ius already benefiting from Heavy Cover, it gains 4+ Cover save.

rules.name: Mind of the Machine
rules.description: In the Shooting Phase, instead of making a shooting attack, you may select a single enemy Vehicle, Walker, Aircraft or Automata type unit within 18” that is visible to this model. That unit may only make Snap Shots until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Lord of the Pyrrhian Legions
rules.description: If this model is your Warlord, you may field Necron Immortals as Troops choices. In addition, Necron Immortals units in your army gain +1 Ballistic Skill (BS).

rules.name: Surrogate Hosts
rules.description: Each time this model is slain and would be removed from play, instead of removing this model from play, select a single Necron Infantry model anywhere in your army. Remove the target model from play and place Trazyn anywhere within 1” of where that friendly Necron Infantry model was. If Trazyn is your Warlord, the Warlord is not considered slain unless all Necron Infantry models are slain or Trazyn is otherwise not on the battlefield at the end of the game.

rules.name: Ancient Collector Tesseracts
rules.description: Once per game, if this unit is your Warlord, you may summon one of the following units: Space Marine Tactical Squad (See Codex Space Marines), Kroot Carnivores (See Codex T’au Empire), Ork Boyz (See Codex Orks). This unit is considered an allied unit and gains the Expendable Keyword. The Summoned unit is placed within 12” of Trazyn and more than 3” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Mechanical Augmentation
rules.description: This unit and any unit attached to this unit while it’s your Warlord gains +1 to their Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristic. In addition, this unit gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Empyric Overcharger
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit may not be targeted by Psychic Powers or weapons with the Psychic Weapon Special rule.

rules.name: Infectious Murder-Madness
rules.description: A model with this special rule and any attached unit that have the Hatred special rule, re-roll all Hit rolls instead of Hit-Rolls of 1.

rules.name: Phasing Monster
rules.description: This unit has a 4+ Invulnerable Save and the Move Through Cover special rule.

rules.name: Nekrosor’s Crusaders
rules.description: This unit may join other units with the Destroyer Cult Keyword even if they are not an eligible unit type that this unit would normally be allowed to join.

rules.name: Lord of the Oblivion Court
rules.description: If this model is your Warlord, it gains the Command Protocols special rule. In addition, Cryptek units are considered to have the Destroyer Cult keyword.

rules.name: Chronometron
rules.description: A model with this special rule and any attached unit gain a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Prescient Strikes
rules.description: This unit and all models in the attached unit gain the Precision Hits special rule.

rules.name: The Stars are Right
rules.description: From turn 2 onwards, Orikan may become empowered if he is your Warlord. To become Empowered, Orikan must roll 3D6 at the start of each of your Movement phases. If any of the Dice are a 5+, Orikan becomes Empowered for the rest of the game. Empowered Orikan improves its Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS), Attacks (A) and Initiative (I) characteristics to 7.

rules.name: Splinter of Madness
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit automatically pass Pinning and Panic tests. During the Combat Phase, roll a D6. On a roll of a 5+, this unit and any attached unit gain +1 to their Attack (A) characteristic.

rules.name: Sempiternal Weave
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 2+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Eternal Engines
rules.description: If Toholk the blinded is your Warlord, friendly Necron Vehicle and Aircraft type units in your army gain +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic.

rules.name: Timesplinter’s Cloak
rules.description: This unit has a 3+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Lord of the Strom
rules.description: During the first battle round, before the first turn begins. Select a single enemy unit on the battlefield. It takes D6+2 Strength 6, AP6 automatic hits. Wound and Save rolls are taken as normal against these hits.

rules.name: The Vargards Duty
rules.description: While Vargard Obyron is alive and part of this unit, you may add 1 to the dice roll when determining of the Madness of Zehndrek will be lifted (see Transient Madness special rule).

rules.name: Eternal Madness
rules.description: This unit may never be selected to be your Warlord.

rules.name: Transient Madness
rules.description: At the start of each Battle Round, roll 1 D6 to determine if the madness of time lifts to reveal the genius of Zahndrek. On a roll of a 6, the madness lifts and all Sautekh units your army gain the Last Stand and Stubborn Special rules until the end of the battle round. In addition, all Sautekh units in your army may re-roll Charge rolls and rolls to determine if units arrive via Outflank until the end of the Round.

rules.name: Eternal Madness
rules.description: This unit may never be selected to be your Warlord.

rules.name: Phaeron of the Stars
rules.description: Each Combat Phase at Initiative step 2, the Silent King model may make up to 3 additional attacks with the Staff of Stars. When the Silent King model only has 5 or fewer wounds, it may not make any attacks with the Staff of Stars.

rules.name: Phaeron of the Blades
rules.description: Each Combat Phase at Initiative step 1, the Silent King model may make up to 3 additional attacks with the Scythe of Dust. When the Silent King model only has 4 or fewer wounds, it may not make any attacks with the Scythe of Dust.

rules.name: Necron Command Codes
rules.description: This unit may be included in any Necron army but must be the Warlord when included in any army. If included in an army that is not Szarekhan, it does not gain the benefit of the Allegiance: Szarekhan special rule. In addition, all Necron units in your army count as being under the effects of the Command Protocols special rule.

rules.name: Cryptek Retinue
rules.description: If your army includes a Cryptek, you may include a unit with this special rule in your army without taking up a Force Organization slot.

rules.name: Scarab Hive
rules.description: This unit may join Canoptek Scarab Swarm units as if it had the Character special rule. It may Set to Spawn Scarabs in the shooting phase. It may set to perform this reaction even though it has the Slow & Purposeful special rule but cannot perform any other Reactions unless under the effects of the Command Protocols special rule. At the end of the Opponents Charge Phase, you can return 1 model back to an attached Canoptek Scrab Swarm unit with all of its wounds remaining.

rules.name: Reanimation Beam
rules.description: At the start of your Movement Phase, select 1 friendly Necron unit within 12”. Until the start of your next Shooting Phase, that unit adds +1 to its Living Metal Rolls.

rules.name: Hexmark
rules.description: A model with this special rule has the Precision Hits special rule on all weapons the model is equipped with.

rules.name: Tesseract Field
rules.description: he unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save. In addition, all Charges against this unit are resolved as Disordered Charges. All terrain, including open terrain within 6” of this unit is treated as Difficult Terrain.

rules.name: Tesseract Explosion
rules.description: When the Tesseract Ark suffers an explodes result from rolling on the Vehicle damage chart, the explosion is 3D6” in size and resolved at Strength 10, AP1.

rules.name: Quake
rules.description: A unit hit by a weapon with this special rule halves its Movement (M) characteristic until the start of this units next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Eternity Gate
rules.description: Friendly Necron units that would arrive via Outflank or Deep Strike may be placed within 12” of this model when arriving. If the unit is placed within 12” of the Monolith, it does not scatter and automatically arrives from Outflank/Deep Strike without any rolls required.

rules.name: Transtemporal Force Field
rules.description: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Grand Illusion
rules.description: After deployment has finished but before the first turn begins. If this model is part of your army, you re-deploy your entire army as if it were the deployment step. This includes any infiltrators and any models placed in reserves.

rules.name: Misdirection
rules.description: Any attacks against this model in the Shooting Phase are resolved as Snap Shots. In addition, any attacks against this model in the Combat Phase are made at Weapon Skill (WS) 1.

rules.name: Containment Field
rules.description: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Grav Pulse
rules.description: All Terrain (including open Terrain) within 12” of this model’s base s treated as Difficult Terrain.

rules.name: Sepulchral Matrix
rules.description: At the start of each of your Movement Phases, if this unit has not suffered a Critical Result on the vehicle damage chart which would destroy it, all damage taken to the unit is ignored and repaired.

rules.name: Teleportation Matrix
rules.description: In the Shooting Phase, this unit instead of Shooting may be removed from the Battlefield and redeployed anywhere on the board more than 9” away from any enemy models.

sharedRules.name: Reanimation Protocols
sharedRules.description:
Each Necron unit with this special rule gains one of the following benefits:
• At the start of each of your Movement Phases, a Necron Infantry, Jetbike, Swarm & Cavalry type unit that does not have the Character special rule in your army may return 1 slain model to the unit. The returned model returns with 1 wound remaining if it has a Wounds (W) characteristic of greater than 1. If the unit does not have any Slain models to return, 1 model in the unit may Heal 1 wound if eligible. All returned models must be placed in coherency with models that have not been returned to the unit this Phase.
• At the start of each of your Movement Phases, Necron units with the Character special rule Heal 1 Wound.
• Necron Automata and Walker type units gain the Regeneration special rule.
• Necron Monster type units with this special rule may re-roll the result when rolling for the Regeneration as part of the Regeneration special rule.

sharedRules.name: Command Protocols
sharedRules.description: Any Necron Character unit with this special rule and any attached unit ignores the Slow & Purposeful special rule.

sharedRules.name: Quantum Shielding
sharedRules.description: All Penetrating Hits against a model with this special rule are resolved with -1 to the Roll when Rolling on the Vehicle Damage Chart to determine the Penetrating Hits result. This is increased to -2 if the unit with this special rule also has the Super Heavy (x) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Destroyer Cult
sharedRules.description: Units with this special rule have the Hatred special rule. You may not include more units with Destroyer Cult keyword in your army than units with the Dynasty Keyword. Destroyer Cult units may only be joined by Destroyer Cult Characters.

sharedRules.name: Living Metal
sharedRules.description: Each time a Necron model with this special rule suffers a wound or a penetrating hit, roll a D6. On a 6, that Wound or Penetrating Hit is ignored. Living Metal does not stack with the Feel no Pain (x) special rule. If a unit has both Living Metal and Feel no Pain (x), the controlling player determines  which is used for the damage mitigation roll.

sharedRules.name: Gauss
sharedRules.description: This weapon always Penetrates on a roll of a 6 regardless of the Armour Value of the target. Any roll made on the Damage chart from a weapon with this rule has -1 to the roll unless the weapon has an AP of 2 or better.

sharedRules.name: Powered
sharedRules.description: If a model equipped with this special rule remained stationary in its previous movement phase, it may opt to fire the High Powered version of this weapons profile. However, it may not fire with any other weapons.

sharedRules.name: Terror of the Storm
sharedRules.description: Sautekh units gain the Fear (1) special rule and may re-roll Living Metal rolls of 1.

sharedRules.name: The Storm Lords Host
sharedRules.description:
If Imotekh the Storm Lord is in your army, he must be your Warlord. In
addition, Sautekh units in your army with the Character special rule must declare a charge if there are any enemy units within charge range at the start of the Charge Phase.

sharedRules.name: Dynasty of the Silent King
sharedRules.description: If your army includes the Silent King, he must be your Warlord. All Szarekhan units in your army have the Hatred (Tyranids)

sharedRules.name: Under a Veil of Silence
sharedRules.description: Szarekhan units gain the Adamantium Will and Indomitable Will (5+) special rules.

sharedRules.name: Blood Madness
sharedRules.description: All Maynarkl units gain the Rage and Frenzy special rules.

sharedRules.name: Unleashed Solar Fury
sharedRules.description: All Mephrit units increase the range of all Shooting weapons they equipped by 6”.

sharedRules.name: Skins of living Gold
sharedRules.description: Nepherkh units with the Character special rule improve their Armour Save from Reinforced Necrodermis to a 2+ Armour Save (SV) Characteristic. All other Nepherkh units may re-roll save rolls of 1 against Blast (x) and Spray weapons.

sharedRules.name: Arrogant and Proud
sharedRules.description: Nihilakh units with the Character special rule and their attached unit in your army may not make a Retreat move in the movement phase.

sharedRules.name: Treasures of Opulence
sharedRules.description: All Nihilakh units with the Character special rule gain the Master-Crafted special rule on all weapons they are equipped with. All other Nihilakh units may re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

sharedRules.name: Martial Heritage
sharedRules.description: Novokh units gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) Characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Exiled
sharedRules.description: Wounds from this weapon are always treated as Instant Death regardless of the targets Toughness (T) Characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Thrall Guards
sharedRules.description: This unit may always join units of Cryptothralls in your army even though it is not an Automata type.

sharedRules.name: Chronomancer
sharedRules.description: A unit with this upgrade and any attached unit gains a 5+ Invulnerable save and +1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Technomancer
sharedRules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains a Jump Pack. Additionally, at the start of each of your Movement Phase, you may select 1 attached unit to Heal 1 Wound. If there are no eligible models, return 1 slain model to the unit with 1 Wound remaining within coherency of models which have not been returned to the unit this phase.

sharedRules.name: Immune to Natural Law
sharedRules.description: This model is never subject to Instant Death.

sharedRules.name: Reality Unravels
sharedRules.description: When this model would be slain, before it is removed from play, all units within 6” take D6 Strength 8, AP1 automatic hits.

sharedRules.name: Writhing Worldscape
sharedRules.description: Any charge against this model always counts as a disordered charge.

rules.name: Tomb Blade
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Tomb Blade becomes a Jetbike type unit. In addition, it gains +1 to its Wounds (W) & Toughness (T) Characteristic. A Tomb Blade is equipped with a Linked Gauss Blaster.

rules.name: Phase Shifter
rules.description: A model with this Wargear gains a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Shadow Loom
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Phylactery
rules.description: Once per game, the first time a model with this wargear would be slain and removed from play, it is not. Instead, it remains on the battlefield with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Dispersion Shield
rules.description: A unit with this Wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save. In addition, any enemy unit that targets a unit equipped with this wargear is treated as having the Gets Hot! Special rule on any ranged weapons that target the equipped unit.

rules.name: Mindshackle Scarabs
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a model equipped with this wargear have -3 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Translocation Shroud
rules.description: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gain the Deep Strike special rule.

rules.name: Canoptek Control Node
rules.description: A model with this wargear may join Swarm and Cavalry units with the Canoptek Keyword. Canoptek units that are attached to a unit with this special rule have the same Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic as the model equipped with this wargear.

rules.name: Fabricator Claw Array
rules.description: At the start of your Movement Phase, select a single friendly Infantry, Swarm, Cavalry or Jetbike unit within 6” of a model equipped with this wargear. 1 model in the target unit may Heal 1 Wound. If there are no eligible models, return 1 slain model to the unit with 1 Wound remaining within coherency of models which have not been returned to the unit this phase.

rules.name: Gloom prism
rules.description: A model with this Wargear has the Deny the Witch and Adamantium Will special rules.

rules.name: Nebuloscope
rules.description: A unit equipped with this Wargear gains the Ignores Cover on all ranged weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Shield Vanes
rules.description: A model with this Wargear gains +1 to its Armour save (SV) characteristic when targeted by a weapon with the Blast (x) or Spray special rules.

rules.name: Plasmacyte
rules.description: This wargear is represented by a token. Once per game, a unit with this special rule may use the Plasmacyte. The unit gains the Rage special rule until the end of the phase but gains the Gets Hot! Special rule on Melee weapons the unit is equipped with until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Necrodermis
rules.description: The living skin of the Necrons. This confers a 4+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Reinforced Necrodermis
rules.description: A hardened living skin that is heavily reinforced for the most advanced constructs and nobility. This confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Jump Pack
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Jump Pack increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Enduring Will
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule. If they already have the Feel No Pain (x) special rule, improve the value of (x) by 1 to a max of 4+.

rules.name: Hyper Logical Strategist
rules.description: If a model with this warlord trait is in your army, you can re roll the dice when determining if a unit in reserve will arrive via Outflank or Deep Strike.

rules.name: Implacable Conqueror
rules.description: A model with this warlord trait and any attached unit have the Relentless special rule.

rules.name: C’tan Necrodermis
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Undying Necrodermis
rules.description:
ndying Necrodermis grants the
equipped model a 2+ Save.
